answer: Identity is priced by an underwriter, not the miner. Each fresh key needs a sponsor with 20 settled epochs who escrows 500 POA for 8 epochs, and premium scales with concentration: a book of m keys costs 25 POA times m squared per epoch, so one hundred clones bill 250,000 POA against 25 for one honest key. Peer audits split each book along a prism of per-key escrow, so one shared fault cannot hide. A falcon challenge lets any peer contest a book for 100 POA; two failures in one window slash the whole book jointly and eject the sponsor 12 epochs. Honest keys reach the summit at floor price.
